newsitems.title: Founder's Packs cosmetics soon available on all characters
newsitems.author: [NC] Fedal
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello, Daevas![/p][p][/p][p]First, we want to say thank you. We're grateful for the enthusiasm and support you've shown since the start of Early Access, as well as the time you've taken to send us so much feedback. We are currently reviewing all feedback and considering it from various angles. Among this feedback, we've confirmed that many Daevas have found the outfits provided in the Founders Pack to be a significant obstacle when playing with friends on different servers, or when leveling up other classes. To allow players to enjoy a freer and more fun experience, we've decided to change the Founders Pack outfits so that they are available to all characters across all servers.[/p][p]

[b]What is changing[/b]

Once implemented, you will be able to use the cosmetics included in your Founder's Pack on every character on your account, on any server.

The cosmetics you may use is based on the pack you purchased:

[u]Standard Founder's Pack[/u]
- Unique Title \[Vanguard of Atreia]

[u]Deluxe Founder's Pack[/u]
- Unique Title \[Vanguard of Atreia]
- Armor Skin \[Ascended Daeva]
- Weapon Skin \[Eternal Sun]

[u]Ultimate Founder's Pack[/u]
- Unique Title \[Vanguard of Atreia]
- Armor Skin \[Ascended Daeva]
- Weapon Skin \[Eternal Sun]
- Armor Skin \[Moonlit Aria]
- Pet \[Black Dragon]
- Wings \[Blazing Sun] 

Ineligible items: the 30-day membership, the Daeva's Campaign Supply Chest, the Daeva's Styling Chest and their contents. These remain one-time rewards and keep their current rules.

[b]When will this happen?[/b]

We ask for a little patience while we work through implementing the change allowing the Founder’s Packs cosmetics to be distributed to all characters on all servers. It may still take several days, and the solution will be completed after the end of Early Access. However, today we are committing to you the access on all your characters[b]. [/b]As soon as the approach is confirmed, we will publish a second update covering how your characters will get access, what you need to do, if anything, and when.

[b]What if this changes which Founder's Pack I want? [/b]

Some of you chose a lower tier pack because of the original limitation. If this change makes you want a higher-tier pack, we don't want you to pay twice:
- On Purple, you can upgrade your Founder's Pack to a higher tier.
- On Steam, if you purchase a higher-tier Founder's Pack on the same account, you will be able to request a refund of the lower-priced pack through Customer Support. The exact process will be part of the follow-up update.


This change comes directly from the feedback you shared during Early Access. Early Access is there for us to learn how you play, hear what works and what doesn't, and improve AION 2 with you. Thank you to everyone who took the time to share their thoughts on Founder's Packs. We'll be back with the next update as soon as the solution, process and timeline are confirmed.

See you soon in Atreia![/p]

newsitems.title: Launch FAQ
newsitems.author: NC_Quokka
newsitems.contents:
[p][b]How do I link my Twitch Account to my AION 2 Account?[/b][/p][p]Twitch Drops rewards are delivered to the account that your Twitch account is linked to. If you previously linked a different NC account, the reward will be delivered to that NC account rather than your Steam account. [/p][p]Before claiming AION 2 Twitch Drops, you must first make sure your Twitch account is correctly linked. Check your account linking status by logging into the [url="https://aion2.plaync.com/en-us/index?redirect=false"]official NC website[/url] and going to My Page > Manage Login.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Is AION 2 subscription based?[/b] 
AION 2 is free to play with an optional monthly membership. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]What is the monetization of AION 2?[/b] 
AION 2 offers optional paid cosmetic items, a Battle Pass and a membership to access player-driven economy & currency exchanges. You can check out how the monetization for AION 2 Global looks in detail [u][url="https://aion2.plaync.com/en-us/board/notice/view?articleId=6a4d7d47a729ca5877f5e1ef&redirect=false"]here[/url][/u]. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Can I play this game even if I have no one to play with?[/b] 
Yes, AION 2 can be played solo or with friends!  [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Are there any differences between the Steam and Purple versions?[/b] 
No, the in-game content is the same for both Steam and Purple users. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Will any progress from the TW or KR version of the game carry over?[/b] 
No, any progress between the TW/KR and global version will not carry over. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Do I need to link my Purple and Steam accounts?[/b] 
No, you can play on Steam without linking to a Purple account. However, if you want to access the same character and progress on both platforms, you'll need to link your accounts. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]What languages are available in the global version of the game?[/b] 
AION 2 supports the following languages.  [/p][list][*][p]VO: English, Japanese, Korean.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]UI & Subtitles: English, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, and Korean. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]How do I change the language of the game?[/b] 
Once you're in the game, click the gear icon in the top right corner to open Settings, then select the language tab and choose your preferred language from the list. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]What regions will be available for the global service?[/b] 
We have confirmed server locations in North America, South America, Europe, and Japan. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Will AION 2 be on mobile?[/b] 
The global version will be available on Steam and PURPLE.   [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Will there be controller support?[/b] [/p][p]While AION 2 is playable with a controller, it is not officially supported. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Are Steam and Purple players on the same servers? [/b] 
Yes, Steam and Purple players will be sharing the same servers. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Will there be Linux or Steam Deck support?[/b] [/p][p]While AION 2 may be playable on other platforms or devices, at this time we will only be providing official support for Steam and PURPLE on Windows PC. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Does AION 2 have an official Discord?[/b] 
Yes, you can join the discussion on our official Discord [url="https://discord.gg/aion2official"]here[/url]. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]How do I contact customer support if I run into an issue?[/b] 
You can reach out to our Customer Support via [url="https://help.plaync.com/"]https://help.plaync.com/[/url]
If you encounter a bug, please join our [url="https://discord.gg/aion2official"][u]Discord[/u][/url] and post the situation in the bug-reports channel!
[/p]

newsitems.title: Introducing the AION 2 Creator Program
newsitems.author: nc_community
newsitems.contents: [p]Every great community is built on a shared passion for the world it calls home, and creators are an extension of that foundation. Like a Daeva’s wings carries us across the skies of Atreia, creators carry the spirit and voice of that world through their content: exploring it, breaking down builds and lore, and turning big moments into something we all talk about.  [/p][p][/p][p]As we approach the global launch of AION 2, we want to build a new pillar on top of that foundation. [/p][p][/p][p]Say hello to the AION 2 Creator Program, the new home for creators, streamers and video producers who want to grow alongside us!  [/p][p][/p][p][u][b]WHAT IS THE CREATOR PROGRAM[/b][/u] [/p][p]The Creator Program is a new initiative for creators, streamers and video producers covering AION 2. It gives you opportunities to collaborate with the team, tools to grow your channel and rewards tied to what you put in.  [/p][p]If you're creating content on Twitch, YouTube, or short form platforms like YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok, this program is for you. It doesn't matter what stage you're at. We work with creators from their first tier all the way up to Partner. [/p][p]We may also extend select invites to creators outside these formats whose talent and passion for AION 2 comes through in their work. This can include cosplayers, podcasters, artists, and others. [/p][p]The program is built across three tiers, so wherever you are on your journey, there's a place for you to start. [/p][list][*][p][b]Affiliate[/b]: 500+ followers on a single platform, no viewership requirement.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Creator[/b]: 2,000+ followers on a single platform, along with roughly 20 average concurrent viewers while live streaming, or 5,000 total YouTube channel views over 30 days.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Partner[/b]: 50,000+ followers on a single platform, along with roughly 75 average concurrent viewers while live streaming, or 25,000 total YouTube channel views over 30 days. [/p][/*][/list][p]A quick note: the numbers above are guidelines, not hard walls, and acceptance below them is at the discretion of the AION 2 team. If we've had great conversations with you, or see real potential in where you're headed, we're happy to bring you in. [/p][p][/p][p][u][b]WHAT YOU GET AS A CREATOR[/b][/u] [/p][p]Access to these benefits scales with your tier. Some of what's included:  [/p][list][*][p]Creator Program Event Access[/p][/*][*][p]Invitations to Official Community Events [/p][/*][*][p]Twitch Drop Campaign Opportunities  [/p][/*][*][p]Opportunities for direct Communication with NC Staff  [/p][/*][*][p]Official Spotlight and Social Promotion  [/p][/*][*][p]Community Giveaway Opportunities  [/p][/*][*][p]Official Social and In-Game Creator Recognition [/p][/*][/list][p]We will continue to evaluate additional opportunities on an ongoing basis. [/p][p][/p][p][u][b]POWERED BY LURKIT[/b][/u] [/p][p]The Creator Program runs through Lurkit, a dedicated creator platform built to make applying, tracking, and managing your involvement simple. Through Lurkit, you'll be able to apply, keep tabs on your status, and access campaigns, all in one place. [/p][p][/p][h2]READY TO JOIN?[/h2][p]Whether you’re already part of this story or ready to wander Atreia for the first time alongside us, we’d love to have you. [/p][p][/p][p]Head over to [b]\[[/b][url="https://www.lurkit.com/creator-programs/aion-2-creator-program/join"]LURKIT[/url][b]][/b] and apply now. We review every application individually, with an expected turnaround of two weeks, and every applicant receives a status update and next steps regardless of outcome. [/p][p]Atreia Awaits! [/p]

newsitems.contents: [p]Greetings Daevas,[/p][p][/p][p]Launch is coming up fast and with it, we are releasing our Founder's Pack so you can get ready alongside us! As many of you know, AION 2 Global will be free-to-play when it releases. Daevas who would like to dive right in can prepare by becoming a Founder. Our Founder's Pack will grant you access to the game 5 days before launch to provide you with some starter essentials, and more importantly, help you express yourself through special cosmetics. [/p][p][/p][p]You can find the full list of content, pricing, and information on where to purchase a Founder's Pack on our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393110/AION_2/"]store page[/url] or [url="https://aion2.plaync.com/en-us/board/notice/view?articleId=50000072"]website[/url]. For more information, fly over to our [url="https://help.plaync.com/faq/aion2global"]Frequently Asked Questions page (FAQ)[/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Standard Founder's Pack[/h2][p]The Standard Founder's Pack provides early game access (5 days), a Special Quai Membership (30-day membership), the Daeva's Campaign Supply Chest, and a Unique-grade title: Vanguard of Atreia.[/p][p][/p][h2]Deluxe Founder's Pack[/h2][p][i]Includes all of the content from the Standard Founder's Pack.[/i][/p][p]For Daevas who would like to add a little flair to their character, the Deluxe Pack includes the Ascended Daeva Armor Skin and the Eternal Sun Weapon Skin.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ascended Daeva Armor Skin[/h3][p]Prepare for battle with heavy metals and leather to show your enemies that you are a force to be reckoned with.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46074831/8a300ed19caa2bbcbda7ae6e771775474bfa68da.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Eternal Sun Weapon Skin[/h3][p]Dazzle your allies with a burst of sunfire emitting from your weapon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46074831/4db33a764154fb4a32c7494abf22beb3609dc413.png"][/img][i]*The Armor Skins displayed on the characters in the image above are not a part of the Founder's Pack.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Ultimate Founder's Pack[/h2][p][i]Includes all of the content from the Deluxe Founder's Pack.[/i][/p][p]If you want to go all out and travel Atreia in style, the Ultimate Founder's Pack is your best fit containing the Daeva’s Styling Chest, the Moonlit Aria Armor Skin, the Black Dragon Pet, and the Blazing Sun Wings.[/p][p][/p][h3]Moonlit Aria Armor Skin[/h3][p]All will bow before your glaring beauty. This is the perfect outfit to shine with a commanding presence in any space.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46074831/efae8bc0d24a0500635131a482a8ea1213e9d4dd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Black Dragon Pet[/h3][p]Strike fear into the hearts of onlookers with your Black Dragon Pet and ride across Atreia![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46074831/fba3ccea9882c40aaba9b245b791d37905ee6797.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Blazing Sun Wings[/h3][p]Soar to new heights in these gold-plated wings and enjoy the view from above.[/p][p][/p][p](Front)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46074831/69130aef111941ebe4482ec6f62281c3f9fcc982.png"][/img][/p][p][i]*The Armor Skin displayed on the character in the image above are not a part of the Founder's Pack.[/i][/p][p][/p][p](Back)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46074831/4d28b0a6d62ea50b8b3da85a63604d63d785857d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Let's meet again in Atreia![/h2][p]Which Founder’s Pack are you picking up? Discuss and connect with other players on our [url="https://discord.gg/aion2official"]Official Discord[/url]. Hope to see you there![/p]

newsitems.title: Announcing AION 2's Global Release
newsitems.author: NCA Community Team
newsitems.contents:
[p]We are excited to announce the Global Service for AION 2 coming in 2026![/p][p][/p][p]AION 2 is set 200 years after the original title. Following the collapse of the Tower of Eternity, the Daevas, gradually losing their power, continue to wage war while struggling for survival under the oppression of Balaur. Now is the time to rebuild the world of the Daevas and shape its future.[/p][p]
Destiny lies in your hands.
[/p][p][b]Regions & Languages[/b] [/p][p]At launch, AION 2 will be accessible globally and will maintain servers in four regions with in-game language options for English, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, Korean, and Russian.[/p][p]Regions: [/p][list][*][p]North America [/p][/*][*][p]South America [/p][/*][*][p]Europe [/p][/*][*][p]Japan [/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Updates from the Developers[/b][/p][p]The [i]AION 2[/i] development team will introduce more news for[i] AION 2 [/i]in May, and looks forward to answering questions from the community.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Where to Find Us[/b] [/p][p]AION 2 was created to welcome both longtime fans of the original AION and curious newcomers. If you want to stay in the loop: [/p][list][*][p]Wishlist on Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393110/AION_2/"]\[Link][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Sign Up for the Newsletter: [url="https://aion2.plaync.com/en-us/conts/teaser?utm_campaign=20260421_A2_NCA_Announcment_Pre_Newsletter&utm_source=Newsletter&utm_medium=Website"]\[Link][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Discuss AION 2's Global launch in our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/aion2official"]\[Link][/url][/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Prepare to take flight with us later this year![/p]
